propositions: The documentation link checker must validate both top-level docs index membership and repository-relative link resolution deterministically across a maintained source boundary.
Relative Markdown links and images must resolve from their source directories to targets anywhere within the repository, while rejecting targets that escape repository bounds.
The checker must exclude scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced blocks, inline code spans, and query strings/fragments before file resolution.

Source files include root Markdown, .agents, .github, docs, examples/agent-skills, infra runbooks, src/rebar guides and eval_specs, templates, and tests external/unit fixtures, while excluding .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, and tests/fixtures.

Documentation policy must specify the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, exclusions, and deterministic error reporting with source path, line number, raw target, normalized path, and failure reason.
The duplicate outbound-link parser test must be replaced with the unified checker API while retaining all existing top-level docs index behavior.
